product_summary: Gadopiclenol Injection, also known as VUEWAY™ (gadopiclenol) injection, is a new, highly stable, and macrocyclic gadolinium-based contrast agent (GBCA) approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for use in adult and pediatric patients aged 2 years and older. This injection is designed for use in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the central nervous system (brain, spine, and surrounding tissues) and the body (head and neck, thorax, abdomen, pelvis, and musculoskeletal system). The approved dose for Gadopiclenol Injection is 0.05 mmol/kg, which has been shown to improve the detection and visualization of lesions over unenhanced MRI alone and to provide similar diagnostic efficacy compared to 0.1 mmol/kg of the lower-relaxivity Gadobutrol injection. The product is highly stable and offers the highest relaxivity among gadolinium-based contrast agents available in the United States. The approval of Gadopiclenol Injection follows Priority Review, which is granted for products that are considered significant improvements in safety or effectiveness compared to standard options. The pivotal Phase III studies supporting the approval were designed as crossover studies, comparing MRI of the CNS or MRI of the body with 0.05 mmol/kg VUEWAY injection or unenhanced MRI alone, and 0.05 mmol/kg Gadopiclenol with 0.1 mmol/kg Gadobutrol in adult patients. The studies showed that MRI with Gadopiclenol was non-inferior to MRI with the full dose of Gadobutrol, with Gadopiclenol providing better quality visualization of lesions. No major safety signals were reported during the development of VUEWAY in either adult or pediatric patients, and the adverse events reported during the two Phase III studies were similar for both products administered. The product will be commercialized by Bracco under the brand name VUEWAY™ (gadopiclenol) injection and VUEWAY™ (gadopiclenol) Pharmacy Bulk Package. The strategic collaboration between Bracco and Guerbet in December 2021 resulted in the commercialization of the product independently under different brand names. The collaboration is expected to accelerate access to Gadopiclenol and deliver innovation, better care to patients and caregivers alike.

The mechanical seal rings and sand guard design provide sand resistance, and the pump bowls are FG 250 Grade investment casting non-magnetic. The pump impellers are made of AISI 410 S.S. product_summary: Maleic Anhydride is a chemical compound primarily utilized in the paint industry, where it plays a crucial role in the formulation and application of various types of paints. Maleic Anhydride is a key component in the production of paints, which are used to decorate, protect, and extend the life of natural and synthetic materials. These paints can be broadly classified into decorative paints, which are applied on-site to decorate and protect buildings and other objects, and industrial coatings, which are applied in factories to finish manufactured goods such as cars. The constituents of paints include pigments, binders (resins), extenders, solvents, and additives. Pigments are used to impart color and opacity, while binders, such as resin, form a matrix to hold the pigment in place. Extenders are larger pigment particles added to improve adhesion, strengthen the film, and save binder. Solvents, often referred to as thinners, are used to reduce the viscosity of the paint for better application. Additives are used to modify the properties of the liquid paint or dry film. The binder and solvent, sometimes known as the vehicle, may be dissolved as a solution or carried as a dispersion of microscopically small particles in a liquid. The most important binders in modern paints are acrylic polymers, alkylidene polymers, and epoxy polymers. Acrylic polymers are used in many emulsion paints, based on homopolymers or co-polymers of ethenyl ethanoate (vinyl acetate) and a propenoate (acrylic) ester. Ethenyl ethanoate is manufactured by passing a mixture of ethanoic acid vapor, ethene, and oxygen over heated palladium (II) and copper (II) chlorides. The polymers used in these paints are carried in water, making them better for the environment than paints in which the binders are in organic solvents. Emulsion paints are made by a process known as emulsion polymerization, in which the liquid monomers to be polymerized are first dispersed in water, forming polymers with relative molecular masses of 500000000. Acrylic resins may also be used in industrial paints, either as water-borne emulsion paints or as solvent-borne paints. Solvent-borne industrial paints can have a tough protective finish and are widely used in industry as topcoats, for example on car bodies. The paint frequently comes as two components, the main paint portion typically consisting of an acrylic resin produced by the polymerization of a propenoate ester formed from a polyhydric alcohol (diols and triols). The resulting polyester has numerous hydroxyl groups (-OH) pendant from the polymer backbone, which react with the other compound, often consisting of a polymeric isocyanate such as a trimer of 1,6-diisocyanatohexane (hexamethylene diisocyanate). This reaction proceeds relatively slowly at room temperature, allowing enough time for the paint to be applied, after which the solvent thinner evaporates and the painted item is placed in an oven to accelerate the chemical reaction, greatly increasing the molecular mass of the polymer causing it to become a three-dimensional molecule and form a hard film, resistant to chemicals.

product_summary: Molecular Sieve 4A is a specialized product made from 4A zeolite powder combined with attapulgite clay, resulting in a sodium form of type A zeolite crystal structure. This product features an effective pore opening of approximately 4 angstroms (0.4 nm), making it highly effective in adsorbing molecules with a kinetic diameter of less than 4 angstroms. It is particularly adept at adsorbing simple gas molecules such as oxygen, nitrogen, carbon dioxide, and straight-chain hydrocarbons, while excluding branched-chain hydrocarbons and aromatics. The product is known for its high mass transfer efficiency, high mechanical strength, and durability. It is widely used for drying and removing CO2 from natural gas, LPG, and air. Additionally, it is effective in the removal of hydrocarbons, ammonia, and methanol from gas streams, and in the dehydration of refrigerants and air in air break units of buses, trucks, and locomotives. Molecular Sieve 4A can also be packed in small bags for use as a desiccant for foods, electronics elements, and drugs. The product is manufactured by Luoyang Jalon and is available in various sizes and forms, including beads and pellets. The beads are available in sizes of 8X12 mm (1.6-2.5 mm) and 4X8 mm (3.0-5.0 mm), while the pellets are available in sizes of 1/16 mm (1.5-1.7 mm) and 1/8 mm (3.0-3.2 mm). For optimal storage, it is recommended to keep the molecular sieve in an airtight container to prevent moisture adsorption. The product can be regenerated or activated using thermal regeneration methods such as Thermal Swing Adsorption (TSA) or pressure swing processes (PSA). A properly regenerated or activated molecular sieve can achieve moisture dew points below -100°C, depending on the gas present and the process conditions. The product is manufactured in Henan, China, and is available for long-term supply. The price is negotiable, and the delivery terms are flexible, with payment due upon delivery.

product_summary: Furnace Sorbent Injection (FSI) Technology is a specialized process that involves the direct injection of sorbents into furnaces or boilers, or the mixing of these sorbents with fuel. This technology is primarily utilized in Waste-to-Energy and biomass plants to address critical environmental and operational issues. The sorbents used in FSI are designed to control acid gas emissions, such as SO2 and HF, and reduce fouling and slagging in the furnace or boiler. The high reaction temperature and absence of competitive reactions with CO2 make acid gas capture highly efficient under FSI conditions. Additionally, the injection of sorbents increases the melting temperature of boiler ash, further enhancing the efficiency of acid gas removal. The benefits of FSI technology are significant, including improved SOx capture, debottlenecked flue gas treatment (FGT), savings on incumbent FGT reagent, and reduced residue disposal costs. The sorbents also contribute to anti-slagging and antifouling properties, such as higher heat transfer capacity, increased waste throughput, and reduced maintenance and cleaning costs. The Lhoist product range dedicated to FSI includes Sorbacal, which is based on calcium, magnesium, or other minerals. Each product in this range is tailor-made to meet specific customer needs. The technology is applicable in various industries, particularly in waste-to-energy and biomass plants, where it plays a crucial role in maintaining environmental compliance and operational efficiency.

Safety features include interlocked and lockable guards for all moving parts, with interlocks to sequence drives and reduce the risk of accidental damage. The KL-130 Cooking Extruder is designed to be highly adaptable, with a large number of product shapes and sizes available using existing KoEx dies or those built to customer requirements.

product_summary: The Dengue Ag Rapid Test by C Centric Management is a fourth-generation rapid diagnostic test designed for the early diagnosis of acute dengue infections, including both primary and secondary infections. The assay procedure is straightforward, yielding results within 20-25 minutes. The clinical performance of this test includes a limit of detection for the detection of NS1 protein in all four types of dengue virus lysates (I, II, III, and IV), with a detection limit of 0.25 ng/mL as determined on recombinant dengue NS1 antigen from serotype 2 (DEN2). The sensitivity of the test is 100%, and the specificity is 98.8% compared to a commercial ELISA. It does not exhibit cross-reactivity with other diseases such as chikungunya, ZIKV, malaria, leishmania, and Typhoid, and it does not interfere with common substances like Albumin (60 g/L), Bilirubin (20 mg/dL), Creatinine (442 µmol/L), EDTA (3.4 µmol/L), Glucose (55 mmol/L), Heparin (3,000 U/L), Salicylic acid (4.34 mmol/L), Sodium citrate (3.8%), and Human IgG (1,000 mg/dL). Additionally, no dose hook effect was detected with the dengue NS1 antigen concentration up to 200 μg/mL during the study. This test is categorized under CTK, Dengue, and Rapid Diagnostic Test (RDT) and is identified by the SKU R0063C.

This plasmid features a C-terminal Flag tag, which is a polypeptide protein tag that can be added using recombinant DNA technology. The Flag tag, or FLAG octapeptide, is used for affinity chromatography, to separate recombinant, overexpressed proteins from wild-type proteins expressed by the host organism, and for the isolation of protein complexes with multiple subunits. The Flag tag can be used in various assays that require recognition by an antibody, such as cellular localization studies by immunofluorescence or detection by SDS PAGE protein electrophoresis. The plasmid is optimized for high expression in mammalian cells and is confirmed by full-length sequencing. The vector used is pCMV3-C-FLAG, and it includes an enhanced CMV mammalian cell promoter. The sequence of the Flag tag is GATTACAAGGATGACGACGATAAG, with a peptide sequence of DYKDDDDK (1012 Da) from the N-terminus to the C-terminus. The plasmid is shipped as a lyophilized product, which can be stored at ambient temperature for up to three months. The sequencing primers for this plasmid are T7 (TAATACGACTCACTATAGGG) and BGH (TAGAAGGCACAGTCGAGG). The plasmid is also tested for antibiotic resistance in E.coli (Kanamycin) and mammalian cells (Hygromycin). This product is ideal for researchers and laboratories working with influenza A H1N1 virus, providing a reliable and efficient method for gene expression and protein isolation.

product_summary: Licowax E Flake is a specialized product composed of an ester of montanic acids, which are straight-chain, unbranched monocarboxylic acids with a chain length ranging from C28 to C32. These acids provide the product with high thermal stability and low volatility, as well as a low tendency to migrate. The product is identified by the master product number MITM02982 and has several SKUs, including ITM01918 and ITM20701, with a CAS number of 73138-45-1. Licowax E Flake is primarily used as a lubricant and dispersing agent in a variety of polymers, including PVC, PS, PBT, PA, PDM, PC, and TPU. It is also applicable in the polish and care industries, such as shoe and leather care, and car care. The product is a hard ester wax with excellent paste-forming properties and is easily emulsifiable. It offers excellent internal and external release properties in PVC and engineering resins like PA and TPU, outperforming standard lubricants. The product's characteristics include a pale yellowish appearance, an acid value of 15-20 mg KOH/g as per ISO 2114, a saponification value of 140-160 mg KOH/g as per ISO 3681, a drop point of 79-83°C as per ISO 2176, and a viscosity of approximately 20 mPa·s at 100°C as per DIN 53019 at 23°C. The density at 23°C is approximately 1.02 g/cm³. Licowax E Flake is suitable for use as a lubricant for plastics, especially engineering resins, PVC, styrenics, and their masterbatches, as well as for elastomers, TPU, and thermosets. It is particularly effective with organic hydrocarbon solvents due to its good paste-forming properties.

product_summary: The AX / AX R with NSPARC Confocal Microscope is a state-of-the-art imaging device designed to deliver exceptional performance in various microscopy applications. This advanced imaging technology significantly enhances the signal-to-noise ratio by increasing the available signal level while allowing imaging with lower excitation power. The NSPARC detector's extremely low noise profile and high sensitivity make it ideal for demanding imaging conditions, including high-speed resonant imaging. The NSPARC noise profile shows extremely low standard deviation in pixel-to-pixel intensity, significantly lower than traditional GaAsP or PMT detectors. This results in high signal-to-noise ratio, sharper images, and superior resolution compared to standard GaAsP or PMT images. The NSPARC detector's array detection technology, comprising 25 detectors, allows for the collection of two-dimensional spatial information from each scanned pixel, enabling ultra-fine structural information to be reconstructed in the result image. This feature is particularly beneficial for live imaging applications, where ultra-short dwell times and the AX R resonant scanner enhance the collection of longer, less phototoxic imaging data. The NSPARC detector's single-photon detection sensitivity and array detection extend the capabilities of the AX system, revealing unseen details in every image and pushing the boundaries of resolution beyond theoretical limits. The AX / AX R with NSPARC Confocal Microscope is designed for high-speed imaging with improved sensitivity, making it perfect for applications requiring rapid image acquisition. With single photon detection sensitivity, the NSPARC detector's extremely low noise profile and exceptional sensitivity enable it to capture images at video frame rates, enabling image acquisition at high speeds. This makes it an ideal tool for live cell imaging timelapse, where the combination of ultra-short dwell times and the NSPARC's sensitivity allows for longer, less phototoxic imaging data to be collected. The microscope's ultra-large 25mm field of view (FOV) supports a wide selection of objectives capable of obtaining image data from large overviews down to extremely fine details. The built-in variable emission optics allow for the prioritization of enhanced optical sectioning or increased overall signal collection depending on specific experimental needs. This flexibility is further enhanced by the NSPARC's array detection, which provides spatial sampling of the confocal point spread function in every pixel, enabling enhanced resolution performance both laterally and axially. The microscope's ultra-large 25mm FOV and variable emission optics support a wide selection of compatible low and high magnification objectives, including silicon immersion objectives that minimize refractive index mismatches, improving overall system performance. The AX / AX R with NSPARC Confocal Microscope is also capable of fast image acquisition of large areas, with super-resolution images of large areas of 2048 x 2048 pixels being acquired at high speed (approximately 6 times faster than with a galvano scanner). This capability is particularly useful for capturing rapid changes in minute structures over large areas. The microscope's high-resolution capabilities are further demonstrated by its ability to create kymographs, which visualize the position of vessel endothelium over time, clearly displaying the pulsatory nature of the endothelial layer. Overall, the AX / AX R with NSPARC Confocal Microscope is a highly advanced imaging device that offers exceptional performance in various microscopy applications, including live cell imaging, high-speed imaging, and super-resolution imaging. Its ultra-low noise, high sensitivity detection, and array detection technology make it an ideal tool for researchers seeking to achieve superior imaging results in demanding conditions.
